svg.title: How Reed works
svg.desc: Hold the shortcut and speak. Reed records, splits the recording at pauses, and sends each segment through on-device denoising, Parakeet v3 speech recognition and cleanup while you keep talking. On release the segments are joined in order and typed at your cursor. Nothing leaves the Mac.
svg.text: How Reed turns your voice into text
Hold, speak, release. Everything runs on your Mac.
Each pause seals a segment and sends it on.
Parakeet v3 on the Neural Engine
Drop the ums, fix the punctuation
Rules first, then Apple Intelligence if needed.
AI edits are checked word by word.
In any app: Mail, Slack, Notes, your editor…

g.text: So let's meet on Thursday after lunch.

svg.text: No audio, transcript or network request leaves your Mac during dictation.
